items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 15 at 8:00PM EDT until October 19 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 8 to 10 feet expected in the surf
zone. Waves currently forecast to peak at 10 to 12 feet Sunday.

* WHERE...The beaches north of Cape Hatteras.

* WHEN...From 2 PM Saturday to 8 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There is potential that high surf advisory
criteria could last through much of the upcoming work-week.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Gale Watch issued October 15 at 3:06PM EDT until October 19 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and
seas 8 to 13 ft possible.

* WHERE...Portions of the adjacent Atlantic coastal waters and
the adjacent Atlantic offshore waters.

* WHEN...From Saturday morning through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
